name: context-engineering-kit
title_zh: 给 Agent 换脑子的手工技能包
tagline_zh: 不是装了就完事——每个技能都调过提示词和上下文结构，让 Claude Code 在复杂任务里少犯浑。
tagline_en: Not just install-and-go — every skill is hand-tuned for prompt & context structure, so agents stay sharp on messy.
desc_en: Hand-crafted Claude Code Skills focused on improving agent results quality. Compatible with OpenCode, Cursor, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, and others. Includes CodeRabbit open-source alternative.
why_zh: 别家卖的是技能数量，这家卖的是上下文工程——每个技能都手工调过提示词与工具边界。
why_en: Sells context engineering, not skill count — each one hand-tuned for prompt & tool boundaries, keeping agents on track through.
limit_zh: 只适配 Claude Code 系（含 OpenCode/Cursor/Antigravity/Gemini CLI）…
limit_en: Claude Code family only (incl. OpenCode/Cursor/Antigravity/Gemini CLI); not full CodeRabbit, just basic review; skills need per-project tweaks, not.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Hand-tuned Claude Code skill pack, open-source CodeRabbit.
